data.text:
Simulated lab monitoring summary:

- Trigger: return-air temp (S3) ~1.1°C above expected and rising. All 5 sensors checked and trusted (none flat/stuck).
- Diagnosis: AC cooling degradation is strongly favored (posterior ~0.98, onset ~30 min ago). Hidden-zone estimate shows rack B ~30.9°C (margin ~4.1°C to its 35°C simulated limit).
- Action tested: shed non-critical load improves peak margin under every plausible hypothesis and delays worst-case breach. Backup cooling to rack B was tested but failed the robustness gate.
- Result: shed-noncritical-load was approved by human and takes effect in ~3 min. It supplements, not replaces, real safety systems.

Continuing to monitor; will escalate if breach risk grows.
